meta.title: Radical Lookup - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Enter a radical to find Chinese characters containing it and their structure types.
desc: Enter a radical to find Chinese characters containing it and their structure types.
ui.2: Enter * to look up standalone characters without a radical; only the first character is used for multi-character input.
ui.3: All radicals (click to fill the input)
ui.6: The common position of a radical in a character determines the lookup order:
ui.7: On the left: the most common position, e.g. 亻 (住), 氵 (清), 扌 (拉).
ui.8: On the right: e.g. 刂 (到), 阝 (都), 攵 (放).
ui.9: On the top: e.g. 艹 (花), 宀 (家), 雨 (雪).
ui.10: On the bottom: e.g. 灬 (黑), 心 (思), 皿 (盆).
ui.11: On the outside: the enclosing frame, e.g. 囗 (国), 门 (问), 辶 (进).
ui.12: On the inside: the enclosed component, e.g. 廴 (建), 囗 (囚).
ui.14: Look at the top over the bottom, the left over the right, and the outside over the inside.
ui.15: If a radical sits in the middle, ignore both sides.
ui.16: The same character may be filed under different radicals in different dictionaries; results follow what this tool covers.
